new_learnings.text: Narrow rally trap: 科创50 +4.69% and 3 major indices green created illusion of broad strength, but Up/Down breadth is 0.46:1 (3734 stocks down vs 1723 up). Mega-cap tech concentration masks broad deterioration — 67% of stocks declining. The 1.5:1 minimum breadth gate correctly prevented entries into a fragile tape where any tech rotation would trigger violent mean-reversion with no bid elsewhere.
new_learnings.mechanism: When large-cap tech carries indices but small/mid-caps decline broadly, the rally lacks participation depth and is vulnerable to sudden reversal. Breadth ratio measures true market participation better than index-level performance alone.

new_learnings.text: All 5 positions profitable with 4 crossing +10% threshold in single session. Mechanical Rule 5 stop-raising converts a strong day into fully risk-managed positions: 上海新阳/路维光电/新宙邦 to breakeven, 兴森科技 to +10% trail. System design working as intended — capturing upside while locking in downside protection without emotional decisions.
new_learnings.mechanism: Mechanical stop-raising after +10%/+20% thresholds removes discretion and protects gains from mean-reversion in extended positions.

new_learnings.text: Candidate pool shows clear bifurcation: semiconductor/optical names have tight MA clusters (奥来德 -0.4%, 路维光电 +3.0%, 芯源微 +4.4%) while materials/chemical names are parabolic (国瓷材料 +38.6%, 三祥新材 +43.3%, 联瑞新材 +59.6% above MA20). Tight-MA group has absorbed selling pressure and is coiling for next leg — these are the priority cohort when breadth recovers.
new_learnings.mechanism: Tight MA clusters indicate controlled consolidation at support — sellers exhausted, buyers accumulating. Parabolic extensions indicate stocks that haven't tested support and carry untested downside risk — any sector cooling triggers disproportionate mean-reversion.
